records.source_span: Lily's robotics club at school meets every other Friday, specifically the first and third Fridays of each month, from 3:15 to 4:30 PM. This started around early March as a trial program at her school.

Lily's swimming lessons are at the Greenfield Aquatic Center every Tuesday and Thursday, 4:30 to 5:15 PM, with Coach Rivera in the intermediate lane. Those started back in mid-January and they've been going great.
records.value: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 4:30–5:15 PM, Greenfield Aquatic Center, Coach Rivera, intermediate lane

records.source_span: I double-checked with the school office and the robotics club actually meets on the second and fourth Fridays, not the first and third like I originally said. Same time, 3:15 to 4:30 PM, but it's definitely the second and fourth Fridays each month.

She also has a Saturday morning art class at Creative Sparks studio on Elm Street, 10 AM to 11:30 AM every Saturday. She's been doing that since late January. She really loves the watercolor work they do there.

records.source_span: starting April 1st, the Tuesday swimming slot moves to 5:00 to 5:45 PM. Thursday stays the same at 4:30 to 5:15 PM.
starting in April the robotics club is switching to every Friday instead of every other Friday, same time slot 3:15 to 4:30
We actually dropped Lily's Wednesday piano lessons with Mrs. Chen at the end of February. She just wasn't connecting with it, and those evenings were so rushed and stressful for everyone.

records.source_span: There's a youth climbing program at Summit Gym starting in April on Saturday afternoons. I like that it's individual and not team-based. I haven't signed her up yet, but I'm seriously considering it.
